description.zh: 把文本按每 5 个比特编码成「若干个“词” + 一个标点」，可选密钥加密、输出语言（喵 / Meow）、零宽隐写。
description.en: Encodes text in 5-bit groups as "N words + a punctuation mark", with optional key encryption, output language (喵 / Meow) and zero-width steganography.

author: 内置示例

description.zh: 非空时用密钥对内容加密，解码需要相同的密钥。
description.en: When non-empty, encrypts with the key; decoding needs the same key.

description.zh: 决定喵语使用的“词”与标点。
description.en: The word and punctuation set used.

description.zh: 开启后数据藏在不可见字符里，肉眼只看到一句随输入变化的短喵话。注意：部分平台（聊天软件、表单等）可能会过滤或丢失零宽字符。
description.en: Hides data in invisible characters; only a short input-dependent sentence is visible. Note: some platforms may strip zero-width characters.
